draft.subject: HIPAA certified and audit proof
draft.body: JotPsych is HIPAA certified and FDA approved. JotPsych runs alongside the system you already use and takes about five minutes to set up. Notes and claims are checked against payer rules before they go out. Reply stop and I will take you off the list.
